player_prompt.intro: Ciyaaryahanka aad tahay waa ciyaaryahanka {player_id} ({piece}). Cadowgaaga waa ({opp}). U gudbi talaabooyinka sida '[b1 c3]' (laga bilaabo → ilaa).
